mapper.insert: INSERT INTO instructors (biography, introduction, greeting, user_id, origin_filename,hashing_filename,filesize) VALUES (#{biography}, #{introduction}, #{greeting}, #{userId}, #{origin_filename},#{hashing_filename},#{filesize})
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT u.username, u.nickname, u.name, u.phone_number, u.email, u.gender, u.created_at AS createdAt FROM users u LEFT JOIN instructors i ON u.id = i.user_id WHERE u.id = #{userId}

SELECT u.username, u.name, u.nickname, u.phone_number, u.email, u.gender, u.created_at AS createdAt, i.biography, i.introduction, i.greeting, i.origin_filename, i.hashing_filename, i.filesize FROM users u JOIN instructors i ON u.id = i.user_id WHERE u.id = #{userId}
SELECT inst.instructor_id FROM Instructors AS inst JOIN users AS u ON inst.user_id = u.id WHERE u.id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE instructors SET biography = #{biography}, introduction = #{introduction}, greeting = #{greeting}, origin_filename = #{origin_filename}, hashing_filename=#{hashing_filename}, filesize=#{filesize} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO courses ( instructor_id, user_id, title, description, summary, url, thumbnail_url, category, level, image, original_image_name, image_size, materials, original_materials, price ) VALUES ( #{instructorId}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{summary}, #{url}, #{thumbnailUrl}, #{category}, #{level}, #{image}, #{originalImageName}, #{imageSize}, #{materialsString}, #{originalMaterialsString}, #{price} );
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(AVG(r.instructor_rating), 0.0) AS avg_instructor_rating FROM reviews r JOIN courses c ON r.course_id = c.course_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT c.course_id AS courseId, c.title AS title, c.description AS description, c.summary AS summary, c.url AS url, c.thumbnail_url AS thumbnailUrl, c.category AS category, c.image AS image, c.original_image_name AS originalImageName, c.image_size AS imageSize, c.level AS level, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.instructor_id AS instructorId, c.user_id AS userId, c.materials AS materials, c.original_materials AS originalMaterials, c.price AS price FROM courses c WHERE c.user_id = #{userId}
